system.boundary: Build a closed-loop autonomous surface-vessel system in Simulink.
engineering_objects: The physical plant must model six-degree-of-freedom vessel motion with inertia, hydrostatic restoring effects, hydrodynamic and current-dependent forces, and two independently driven propellers.
PropulsionState has 6 channels [desired surge thrust (N), desired yaw moment (N*m), left and right propeller command (rad/s), delivered surge force (N), delivered yaw moment (N*m)].
Every recorded value must come from the connected physical, control, traffic-assessment, or planning path.
physical_paths: The controller must use measured vessel motion to track the requested forward speed and waypoint route through bounded propeller actuation.
Every recorded value must come from the connected physical, control, traffic-assessment, or planning path.

functional_paths: The controller must use measured vessel motion to track the requested forward speed and waypoint route through bounded propeller actuation.

information_paths: Waypoints_m, TrafficMotion, DesiredSpeed_mps, CurrentSpeed_mps, CurrentDirection_deg -> F90-XROBO-09 plant/control path -> VesselState, GuidanceState, PropulsionState, TrafficState, OperatingState
modes_and_events: The physical plant must model six-degree-of-freedom vessel motion with inertia, hydrostatic restoring effects, hydrodynamic and current-dependent forces, and two independently driven propellers.

The model must also evaluate the supplied traffic-vessel motion, identify potential close encounters, and perform rule-consistent collision-avoidance manoeuvres before returning to useful waypoint progress.
raw radar, lidar, camera processing, SLAM, wind and wave modelling are not required.

interfaces.name: Waypoints_m
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read Waypoints_m, TrafficMotion, DesiredSpeed_mps, CurrentSpeed_mps, and CurrentDirection_deg from the MATLAB base workspace and support the ranges and formats stated in public_inputs. Waypoints_m is an N-by-2 real matrix in m with columns [x_m, y_m].

interfaces.name: TrafficMotion
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read Waypoints_m, TrafficMotion, DesiredSpeed_mps, CurrentSpeed_mps, and CurrentDirection_deg from the MATLAB base workspace and support the ranges and formats stated in public_inputs. TrafficMotion may contain one, two, or three active traffic vessels. TrafficMotion is a complete-run Timeseries with 18 channels in this exact order: [vessel1_x_m, vessel1_y_m, vessel1_vx_mps, vessel1_vy_mps, vessel1_yaw_rad, vessel1_active_flag, vessel2_x_m, vessel2_y_m, vessel2_vx_mps, vessel2_vy_mps, vessel2_yaw_rad, vessel2_active_flag, vessel3_x_m, vessel3_y_m, vessel3_vx_mps, vessel3_vy_mps, vessel3_yaw_rad, vessel3_active_flag]; inactive rows use active_flag=0.
